edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the transfer origin, so the caller fully controls the sender of token movement.
msg.sender supplies the allowance spender/sender fields in transferFrom, letting the caller spend approved funds.
unlock() authorizes ownership restoration solely by comparing _previousOwner with msg.sender.
Constructor mints the entire reflection supply to _msgSender().
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution minable/manipulable.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline parameter.
lock() computes _lockTime = now + time, a direct timestamp dependency controlling unlock.
transfer delegates the actual balance movement to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the actual balance movement to the internal _transfer.
transfer reads the 'special' lottery flag to conditionally block the lottery address.
transferFrom reads and implicitly mutates lottery state based on the 'special' flag.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify during a user-triggered transfer, entering external calls mid-transfer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to apply fee logic and update balances.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the transfer cap.
_transfer compares the contract balance against numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
_transfer gates the liquify branch on swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
_transfer reads the inSwapAndLiquify reentrancy guard before swapping.
swapAndLiquify performs the token-to-ETH swap through an external router call.
swapAndLiquify performs the liquidity addition through an external value call.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap with no slippage bound.
addLiquidity executes the external addLiquidityETH value call with zero minimums.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router to build the path and grant approval.
addLiquidity reads uniswapV2Router to submit the liquidity transaction.
_approve writes the router allowance in _allowances before swapping.
The router swap transfers ETH back to this contract, re-entering contract code before swapAndLiquify completes.
The external addLiquidityETH call returns control to the contract while swap state is unsettled.
Reflection balances in _rOwned are written in the same transaction that performs external calls.
Token balances in _tOwned are written around external calls, enabling stale-state exploitation.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to the standard transfer path for non-excluded accounts.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to the to-excluded transfer path.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to the from-excluded transfer path.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to the both-excluded transfer path.
_tokenTransfer branches on _isExcluded for sender and recipient.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when fees are waived.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after the fee-waived transfer.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute r/t amounts and fees.
_transferStandard calls _takeLiquidity to fund the liquidity pool share.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to distribute the tax fee.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned balances.
_transferToExcluded calls _getValues for amount computation.
_transferToExcluded writes _tOwned for the excluded recipient.
_transferFromExcluded writes _tOwned for the excluded sender.
_transferBothExcluded writes _tOwned for both excluded parties.
_getValues obtains the tax fee from calculateTaxFee.
_getValues obtains the liquidity fee from calculateLiquidityFee.
_getValues calls _getRate to convert token amounts into reflections.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to obtain effective supplies.
_getRate divides using _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_getCurrentSupply starts from _rTotal and subtracts excluded reflection balances.
_getCurrentSupply starts from _tTotal and subtracts excluded token balances.
_getCurrentSupply iterates the _excluded array.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rOwned of excluded accounts.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tOwned of excluded accounts.
calculateTaxFee multiplies by the mutable _taxFee value.
calculateLiquidityFee multiplies by the mutable _liquidityFee value.
_takeLiquidity calls _getRate for the reflection conversion.
_takeLiquidity credits the contract's _rOwned balance.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
removeAllFee caches and zeroes _taxFee.
removeAllFee caches and zeroes _liquidityFee.
restoreAllFee writes the cached _previousTaxFee back into _taxFee.
restoreAllFee writes the cached _previousLiquidityFee back into _liquidityFee.
excludeFromReward sets _isExcluded[account] to true.
excludeFromReward pushes the account onto _excluded.
excludeFromReward snapshots _tOwned from the reflection balance.
includeInReward clears _isExcluded[account].
includeInReward swaps and pops the _excluded array entry.
onlyOwner setter writes _taxFee with no upper bound, allowing arbitrary fee increases.
onlyOwner setter writes _liquidityFee with no validation.
onlyOwner setter recomputes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxTxPercent performs mul/div scaling that determines the enforced limit.
onlyOwner toggles swapAndLiquifyEnabled, controlling automatic swapping.
onlyOwner assigns the lottery address that transfer blocks.
onlyOwner adds an account to _isExcludedFromFee.
onlyOwner removes an account from _isExcludedFromFee.
Constructor assigns the entire _rTotal supply to the deployer.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap V2 pair address.
Constructor stores the Uniswap V2 router address.
Constructor excludes owner and contract from fees.
Constructor runs Ownable init which sets _owner to the deployer.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
deliver debits the caller's _rOwned balance by rAmount.
deliver reduces _rTotal by rAmount, redistributing to holders.
lock() zeroes _owner and stores _previousOwner, altering access control state.
unlock() restores _owner from _previousOwner after the timelock.
The scaled multiplication/division result is written into _maxTxAmount.
recipient parameter flows into transfer's delegation path.
amount parameter flows into transfer's balance update.
sender parameter determines whose allowance and balance transferFrom mutates.
maxTxPercent parameter feeds the scaling arithmetic in setMaxTxPercent.
contractTokenBalance parameter controls the amount swapped via external calls.
half local is forwarded to the token-to-ETH swap.
newBalance local is passed as the ETH value for addLiquidityETH.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter exists only inside transfer's delegation to _transfer; it carries no independent semantics.
Amount parameter is consumed entirely by transfer's balance update and fee math.
Sender parameter is only used to derive allowance and balance mutations inside transferFrom.
Spender parameter is used solely when writing the allowance inside approve.
Tax fee argument is written straight into _taxFee by the owner setter.
Liquidity fee argument is written straight into _liquidityFee by the owner setter.
Scaling argument is used only inside setMaxTxPercent's arithmetic.
Account argument indexes the exclusion mappings mutated by excludeFromReward.
Source address parameter is used only by the internal _transfer validation and dispatch.
Destination address parameter is used only by the internal _transfer validation and dispatch.
Token balance parameter determines the amounts halved and swapped for liquidity.
Token amount parameter is approved and forwarded to the router liquidity call.
ETH amount parameter becomes the call value for addLiquidityETH.
takeFee local only toggles fee removal/restoration inside _tokenTransfer.
Half local is an intermediate split value used only by the swap routine.
OtherHalf local is an intermediate split value used only by the swap routine.
Initial balance snapshot is used only to measure ETH gained during the swap.
newBalance local is computed in the swap and passed directly to addLiquidity.
Current rate local is the cached result of _getRate used for reflection conversion.
rAmount local is produced by _getValues and consumed by the standard transfer math.
tLiquidity local is computed by _getValues and forwarded to _takeLiquidity.
